timingOwner: Presentation time only. Never change collision, world state, ability timing, input locks, or simulation direction.

effects.anchor: Behind the current presentation-player center; follow the actual traveled segment only.
effects.notes: Three pale cyan tapered streaks. Mirror for leftward travel. Never draw a predicted destination or extend through an untraveled path. The physical echo is a separate sprite.

effects.trigger: Presentation detects a grounded false-to-true change after falling; do not invent a rule event.
effects.anchor: Player feet at the confirmed supporting surface.
effects.notes: Five pale square dust flecks spread at most 0.45 tile each side. No camera shake.

effects.anchor: Bottom center of the plate authored bounds.
effects.notes: Switch plate.up to plate.down immediately when rules change. Two amber ticks escape the sides; animation never delays activation.

effects.trigger: RuleEvent.DeviceChanged for Door or LockWall, state edge only
effects.notes: Two narrow amber edge strokes. Closed/open base frame switches with the rule state; retain a transparent doorway when open. Reverse edge motion for closing, never reverse simulation.

effects.anchor: Center of the checkpoint diamond, 0.65 tile above its base.
effects.notes: One expanding pale-jade diamond ring. No repeating pulse while standing on it; persistent state is checkpoint.active.
Seven warm-white/amber fragments separate and fade. Hide normal player while dead; no full-screen white flash and no reset of echoes or mechanisms.

globalConstraints: Start once per event, not every rendered frame with the same state.
Use independent PNG frame paths; public UiSpriteRequest has no atlas UV rectangle.
FX must not cover spikes, beam intersections, or connection boundaries with opaque quads.
Crop by the actual television map viewport; screen-space effects must not spill into 3D scenery.
Draw the physical echo continuously with echo.idle; forming/dash effects do not indicate early collision activation.
No bloom is baked into the PNGs. Use existing render-target emission/unlit display to retain color; do not raise global GI or scene exposure to compensate.
